### Task 2: OCR-first vision pipeline — drop 80% of vision API calls

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/agent/AgentLoopExecutor.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/perception/VisionPayloadBuilder.kt`

**Goal:** Instead of sending screenshots as vision API payloads on most steps, run OCR locally (ML Kit) and include the extracted text in the loop message. Only send the actual image for visual layout context on step 1 or after major UI changes.


Add import: `import com.phoneagent.perception.OcrManager`

**Step 2: Rewrite the vision capture block in executeSteps()**

Replace the entire `shouldSendScreenshot` block and visionPayload logic (around line 99-122) with:

```kotlin

            when (action) {
```

Key behavior:
- OCR runs on every `shouldSendScreenshot` step (step 1, after UI change, every 3 steps)
- Vision payload (image to LLM) ONLY sent on step 1 or after UI-modifying tool
- When vision not sent, OCR text is appended to the loop message as plain text
- Result: most steps are text-only, ~80% fewer vision API tokens

### Task 3: Accessibility app denylist — protect banking/payment apps

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/accessibility/AppSafetyPolicy.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/accessibility/AgentAccessibilityService.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/agent/SafetyGate.kt`

**Goal:** On a phone with full accessibility, an LLM can read any app's UI tree. Add a hard deny on banking, payment, password manager, and authenticator apps. The a11y tools must check the foreground package before operating.

**Step 1: Create AppSafetyPolicy.kt**

```kotlin
package com.phoneagent.accessibility

object AppSafetyPolicy {

    private val denylistPatterns = listOf(
        // Banking
        "com.ing.", "com.chase.", "com.bankofamerica.", "com.wellsfargo.",
        "com.citi.", "com.capitalone.", "com.usbank.", "com.pnc.",
        "com.td.", "com.rbc.", "com.scotiabank.", "com.bmo.",
        "com.monzo.", "com.revolut.", "com.starlingbank.", "com.n26.",
        "com.nubank.", "com.mercadopago.",
        // Payment
        "com.paypal.", "com.squareup.cash", "com.venmo.",
        "com.google.android.apps.nbu.paisa.", "com.apple.",
        "com.stripe.",
        // Crypto
        "com.coinbase.", "com.binance.", "com.kraken.",
        "com.trustwallet.", "com.metamask.",
        // Password managers
        "com.lastpass.", "com.dashlane.", "com.onepassword.",
        "com.bitwarden.", "com.google.android.apps.password",
        // Authenticators
        "com.google.android.apps.authenticator2",
        "com.azure.authenticator", "com.authy.",
        "com.duosecurity.",
        // System critical
        "com.android.settings.", "com.google.android.permissioncontroller"
    )

    fun isPackageDenied(packageName: String?): Boolean {
        if (packageName == null) return false
        return denylistPatterns.any { packageName.startsWith(it) }
    }

    fun getDenyReason(packageName: String?): String? {
        if (!isPackageDenied(packageName)) return null
        return when {
            packageName?.contains("settings") == true -> "System settings are protected."
            packageName?.contains("password") == true -> "Password managers are protected."
            packageName?.contains("authenticator") == true || packageName?.contains("auth") == true -> "Authentication apps are protected."
            else -> "Banking and payment apps are protected from AI interaction."
        }
    }
}
```

**Step 2: Add foreground package check before all a11y tool operations**

In `AgentAccessibilityService.kt`, add a public helper:
```kotlin
    fun isForegroundPackageDenied(): Boolean {
        val pkg = getForegroundPackage() ?: return false
```

Import `com.phoneagent.accessibility.AppSafetyPolicy`.

### Task 4: Cross-tool destructive action detector

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/agent/DestructiveActionDetector.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/com/phoneagent/agent/AgentLoopExecutor.kt`

**Goal:** SafetyGate evaluates individual tool calls. But the real threat is multi-step: read SMS OTP → type into bank app → click transfer. Add a detector that monitors step sequences for destructive patterns.

**Step 1: Create DestructiveActionDetector.kt**

```kotlin
package com.phoneagent.agent

object DestructiveActionDetector {

    private data class DangerPattern(
        val sequence: List<String>,
        val reason: String
    )

    private val patterns = listOf(
        DangerPattern(
            listOf("phone.notifications", "accessibility.type*", "browser.click_text"),
            "Reading notifications then typing and clicking may indicate credential theft."
        ),
        DangerPattern(
            listOf("accessibility.read_tree", "accessibility.type*", "browser.click_text"),
            "Reading app UI then typing into fields may indicate automated account access."
        ),
        DangerPattern(
            listOf("phone.notifications", "accessibility.read_tree", "phone.send_sms"),
            "Reading notifications + app UI then sending SMS may indicate OTP interception."
        )
    )

    fun assessSequence(steps: List<AgentStep>): String? {
        val toolSequence = steps.mapNotNull { step ->
            when (step.action) {
                is AgentAction.ToolCall -> step.action.tool
                else -> null
            }
        }

        for (pattern in patterns) {
            if (matchesPattern(toolSequence, pattern.sequence)) {
                return pattern.reason
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun matchesPattern(actual: List<String>, pattern: List<String>): Boolean {
        if (actual.size < pattern.size) return false
        val recent = actual.takeLast(pattern.size)
        return recent.zip(pattern).all { (a, p) ->
            if (p.endsWith("*")) a.startsWith(p.dropLast(1))
            else a == p
        }
    }
}
```

**Step 2: Integrate into AgentLoopExecutor**

In `executeSteps()`, after each tool execution (where the observation is added to steps), add:
```kotlin
                    val dangerWarning = DestructiveActionDetector.assessSequence(steps)
                    if (dangerWarning != null) {
                        applyState {
                            it.copy(
                                agentStepStatus = "Warning: $dangerWarning. Proceed with caution."
                            )
                        }
                    }
```

**Step 3: Commit**

```bash

git commit -m "feat: cross-tool destructive action detector for multi-step threat patterns"
```

### Task 5: Rewrite README — sideload notice, permission justification, privacy

**Files:**
- Modify: `README.md`
- Create: `docs/PRIVACY.md`

**Step 1: Rewrite README.md**

Replace the existing content with updated version that includes:

- Warning banner at top: "**This app is sideload-only.** It requests permissions (accessibility, overlay, SMS, phone) that Google Play rejects for non-accessibility-assistance apps. Install via ADB or direct APK."
- Permission table with justification for each:
  | Permission | Why Needed | User Control |
  |-----------|-----------|-------------|
  | SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW | Floating bubble for quick agent access from any screen | Toggle in Permissions screen |
  | BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE | Read screen content and tap/type for the user | Must enable manually in Settings > Accessibility |
  | SEND_SMS | Send SMS on user's behalf (e.g., "text John I'm on my way") | Confirmation dialog before each send |
  | CALL_PHONE | Initiate phone calls (dials, doesn't auto-call) | Confirmation dialog before each call |
  | QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES | List installed apps for the "open app" tool | N/A |
  | RECORD_AUDIO | Voice input for agent commands | Mic button only |
  | POST_NOTIFICATIONS | Foreground service notification | Required for Android 13+ |
- Security section: Keystore encryption, denylisted apps, SafetyGate confirmation, URL sanitization, WebView SafeBrowsing
- Build instructions fixed (gradlew)
- Link to PRIVACY.md

**Step 2: Create docs/PRIVACY.md**

```markdown
# PhoneAgent Privacy Notice

## Data on device
- API keys: encrypted with Android Keystore (AES-256-GCM, hardware-backed)
- Chat history: stored in local Room database
- Task history: stored in local Room database
- Provider config: stored in DataStore (API keys excluded)
- Screenshots: held in memory only, never persisted
- Notifications: held in RAM (max 50), cleared on service stop

## Data sent off-device
- Chat messages: sent to your configured AI provider (CrofAI, OpenAI, Ollama, etc.)
- Screenshots: sent as vision context to AI provider when visual context needed
- API keys: sent as Bearer token headers to AI provider
- Nothing else. No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting.

## App denylist
PhoneAgent refuses to interact with banking, payment, cryptocurrency, password manager,
and authentication apps. The accessibility service will not read or manipulate these apps.

## Recommendations
- Use a dedicated API key with usage limits
- Review task history periodically and clear it
- Do not grant accessibility access if you handle sensitive data on this device
```
